articles.title: GTA 6 kills the one-button hotwire after 20 years
articles.description: Rockstar has confirmed that GTA 6 will drop the one-button hotwire that has defined the series for two decades. Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson told IGN the studio has added "layers of stratification" to vehicles, meaning certain parked cars stay inaccessible until players progress through the story and acquire the right tools.
